notes: wowsims-forever models one Hunter spell package for all three specs; this is the spec the fork's own p1.apl.json preset is already built for (heavy Aimed Shot weaving), so it is the closest adaptation of the three hunter files. Marksmanship also keeps Serpent Sting up for the extra sustained damage, unlike Beast Mastery where community guides call it not worth a global. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst: the preset names Multi-Shot as spell 25294, which does not exist in this build (Multi-Shot only has one rank here, 2643), and calls Serpent Sting rank 8 when 25295 is actually rank 9 -- both fixed here rather than copied stale. Fix round 3: the whole body of sim/hunter/aimed_shot.go's registerAimedShotSpell is commented out, so 20904 is never registered by any hunter build in this engine; the cast line is kept (this is the guide's actual rotation and the engine follow-up is to register it) and declared inert rather than deleted. Aimed Shot being unregistered also makes every spellTimeToReady(20904) reference in this file resolve to a nil APLValue, which an `and` condition silently drops (rot.newValueAnd filters nil operands) rather than nulling the whole condition -- so Rapid Fire's and Serpent Sting's gates above already degrade correctly to their other operand and did not need rewriting. What did need fixing: nothing in this site's request pipeline (sim/request) ever sets a character's DistanceFromTarget, so every hunter starts at 0 -- inside Raptor Strike's melee range but under Multi-Shot, Serpent Sting and Aimed Shot's own ExtraCastCondition floor of 12 (core.MinRangedAttackDistance), which also gates the ranged auto-attack itself (sim/core/attack.go's startPull). A `move` prepull action to 30 yards is added so this and every future simulation of this spec actually has a ranged auto-attack and can cast its ranged abilities, matching how a Marksmanship hunter is actually played. Under this smoke build specifically (no gear equipped anywhere) the ranged weapon's SwingSpeed is the Weapon{} zero value, which collapses the ranged swing timer to its 500ms cast-time floor (sim/core/attack.go's WeaponAttack.updateSwingDuration: curSwingDuration = weapon.SwingSpeed / hasteMultiplier = 0) -- a real ranged weapon's positive SwingSpeed does not have this problem. The resulting sub-GCD auto-shot loop saturates the character's action economy so completely that the priority list, including Multi-Shot and Serpent Sting, never gets a decision window in this one bare-weapon run; this is a new engine-side artifact of the no-gear smoke build (recorded for the engine ledger), not a defect in this rotation's gates.
